# [TASK] Implement Movie Service

## Task
Implement Movie Service: TMDB API integration (with rate limiting), MongoDB storage, Redis caching, and REST endpoints for movie discovery, search, and detail lookup, packaged for deployment via Docker.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] TMDB integration live — discover/search/detail/trending/popular/genres endpoints implemented and working
- [x] Hybrid caching (MongoDB + Redis) functional, TMDB calls rate-limited via Bucket4j
- [x] Registered with Eureka, health checks and OpenAPI docs passing
- [x] Dockerfile standardized, service builds and runs in docker-compose alongside Config Service
- [x] Tests passing at 85%+ coverage — unit tests + TestContainers integration tests

## Estimate
**Hours:** 10-12
